title: Abstract questions and evaluation
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply abstract questions and evaluation in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 回答关于社会变化的抽象问题，明确评价标准与例外。
grammar: 抽象题可分个体与制度层面，避免无证据的时代绝对比较。to some extent、in the longer term 标出程度与时间；one reason is that 展开机制。
common_mistake: 没有历史证据时，不要声称过去所有人都更有耐心。

reading: Instant communication has probably changed what people expect from one another. A message can arrive immediately, but that does not mean its recipient is free to answer. One consequence may be pressure to treat every request as urgent. On the other hand, quick communication can help families coordinate complicated schedules. I would evaluate it by whether people can set reasonable boundaries, not simply by how fast messages travel. In professional settings, agreed response times may be more useful than an expectation of permanent availability.
